name: What is the difference between a roof inspection and a water damage assessment?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a roof inspection and a water damage assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general roof inspection typically covers the overall condition and lifespan of the roof. A water damage assessment, however, specifically focuses on identifying sources of water intrusion, the extent of moisture damage, and potential structural issues caused by leaks. While a general inspection might note a leak, a water damage assessment delves deeper into its impact and necessary remediation. Both are important, but the latter is more targeted when leaks are suspected.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general inspection reviews overall roof health, while a water damage assessment specifically pinpoints water entry points, damage extent, and necessary leak-related repairs.
